name: Coding工作站
description: A managed DSH coding execution domain for AIO Hub.
author: AIO Hub

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Negotiate and initialize the DSH execution domain.

methods.name: acquireSession
methods.description: Acquire a controller or observer lease for a DSH session.

methods.name: transferController
methods.description: Transfer a DSH session controller lease to another view.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Execute a DSH runtime command with a valid controller lease.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Read a durable DSH session snapshot.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully stop the DSH execution domain for the supplied lifecycle reason.
